VBO:0201232.summary: Sweet and affectionate in National Mill Dog Rescue’s account, seven-year-old Angel was a German Shepherd–Pug cross who sought attention, gave face kisses and stayed close to people she trusted. She walked nicely on a leash and enjoyed time outdoors. The rescue also reported that she was not good with other dogs and preferred having people’s attention to herself.
VBO:0201232.shortDescription: NMDR described Angel as an affectionate German Shepherd–Pug cross who gave face kisses and enjoyed outdoor walks.
